title: cyperus digitatus subsp. auricomus
intro: Cyperus digitatus subsp. auricomus, commonly known as Umbrella Sedge or Cyperus sedge, is a species of sedge that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. This plant is traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include the promotion of respiratory health, soothing digestive issues, and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Cyperus digitatus subsp. auricomus are attributed to its ability to act as an expectorant, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory, making it useful for treating coughs, colds, and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
